Disconnection of the power supply - Create

User creates disconnection from listing (Plus). POD table: Express reconnection checkbox after Date of disconnection. After execute, checkbox drives express reconnection tax.

Manual create remains. EMEP can create the object with all required data. Express checkbox removed. Sending time + GO Status added (EMEP-filled, always disabled). After execute: Real Proforma Invoice when express tax amount > 0.

EMEP - Change in Disconnection of power supply

Disconnection of the power supply - Edit

Executed: user can edit Express reconnection. After execute/save, checkbox drives express reconnection tax (skip if amount 0).

Express reconnection removed from user-editable fields. Sending time and GO Status user-disabled; EMEP may update executed objects via API. After execute: Real proforma when express tax > 0; no second proforma on later save.

EMEP - Change in Disconnection of power supply

Disconnection of the power supply - Preview

Preview shows checked PODs; fields disabled on executed objects.

POD table shows Sending time and GO Status (always disabled; empty until EMEP fills them). Express reconnection checkbox is not displayed.

EMEP - Change in Disconnection of power supply
